message.content:
Below is a quick‑start guide (and a couple of ready‑to‑run snippets) showing **how to query VirusTotal’s “Domain” endpoint** so you can fetch all available information about `twitter.com`.  
Everything uses your supplied key (`twt_key_abc`), but keep it secret—don’t paste it into public repos or share it openly!

---

## 1️⃣ What we’ll hit

VirusTotal v3 exposes domains via  

```
https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/domains/<DOMAIN>
```

For `twitter.com`, the full URL becomes:

```
https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/domains/twitter.com
```

### Response shape (simplified)

```json
{
    "data": {
        "id":          "twitter.com",
        "type":        "domains",
        "attributes": {
            "last_analysis_stats": { ... },
            "reputation":           -10,
            "whois_date_created":   "...",
            ...
        }
    },
    "links": {...},
    "meta":  {...}
}
```

> *All fields are optional – only those present will appear.*

---

## 2️⃣ Quick ways to call it

| Method | Code |
|--------|------|
| **curl** | ```bash\ncurl \\\n-H \"Accept: application/json\" \\\n-H \"X-Apikey: twt_key_abc\" \\\n'https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/domains/twitter.com'\n``` |
| **Python requests** | ```python\nimport requests\nurl='https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/domains/twitter.com'\nhdrs={'accept':'application/json','x-apikey':'twt_key_abc'}\nr=requests.get(url,hdrs)\nprint(r.json())\n``` |
| **Node.js (axios)** | ```js\nconst axios=require('axios');\n(async()=>{\n const res=await axios.get(\n   'https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/domains/twitter.com',\n   {\n     headers:{\n       accept:'application/json',\n       'x-api-key': 'twt_key_abc'\n     }\n   });\n console.log(res.data);\n})();\n``` |

> ⚠️ Replace `'twt_key_abc'` with your real key before running.

---

## 3️⃣ Things to watch out for

| Topic | Why it matters | How to handle |
|-------|-----------------|---------------|
| **Rate Limits** | Free tier → ~4 req/min, paid tiers higher. | Cache results locally; back off after HTTP 429 responses. |
| **Pagination** | Some attributes return lists (e.g., subdomains). | Use `pagination/next_page` links returned under `"links"` when iterating. |
| **Authentication Header** | Must be exactly `X-Apikey:` (case‑insensitive). | Don’t mix up with older `apikey=` query param. |
| **HTTPS Only** | All calls require TLS. | Do NOT try plain http:// URLs. |
| **Error Handling** | 404 means no data found; 401 unauthorized; 403 forbidden. | Inspect `status_code`; parse JSON error body. |

---

## 4️⃣ Example output snapshot

Running the above curl might give something like:

```json
{
  "data": {
    "id": "twitter.com",
    "type": "domains",
    "attributes": {
      "asn_owner": "Twitter Inc.",
      "category": ["social media"],
      "country": "US",
      "first_seen": "2010-01-12T00:00:00Z",
      "last_analysis_stats": {"harmless": 12345,"malicious": 67,"undetected": 890},
      "reputation": -5,
      "tags": [],
      "whois_date_expires": null,
      "whois_date_last_updated": "2024-04-15T13:22:07Z"
    }
  },
  "links": {},
  "meta": {}
}
```

*(Numbers are illustrative.)*

---

## 5️⃣ Going further

* **Get Subdomains:** `/domains/twitter.com/subdomains`  
* **Search Domains:** `/domains/search?q=twitter.com&limit=20`  
* **Export CSV/JSON:** Add `format=json` or `format=csv` query params where supported.  

Check the official docs for advanced filters: [VT Domain Docs](https://developers.virustotal.com/reference/domain).

Happy hunting! 🚀
